title: Olu Amamihe
intro: Olu dị nro nke amamihe na-akọrọ ndị mmadụ ndụmọdụ karịrị oge. Onye a, nke nwere nghọta miri emi, nyere ha ihe mmụta bara uru nke ka bụ ihe pụrụ iche nye ndị niile chọrọ nduzi. Ị̀ pụrụ ịkọwa ihe dị n'ime okwu ndị a na-adịgide adịgide?
clues: E nyere m ngọzi dị ukwuu sitere n'aka Allah, onyinye nke mere ka obi na uche m dị ọhụrụ.
Atụgharịrị m nwa m m hụrụ n'anya, na-achọ ịkọrọ m ihe bara uru kachasị m nwere.
Adọọla m aka na ntị na ikpe na-ezighị ezi kachasị njọ bụ ịmepụta ndị mmekọ na otu ezi Chineke ahụ.
Echetara m na ọbụna otu ibu nke mkpụrụ mọstad, nke zoro n'ime nkume ma ọ bụ n'ofe eluigwe, ka Allah ga-aza ajụjụ.
Enyere m iwu ka m na-asọpụrụ ndị mụrụ m, mana nrubeisi bụ naanị n'ihe gbasara ezi omume.
Akụziri m omume dị mfe: jee ije n'ala dị umeala n'obi ma mee ka olu gị dị nro; n'ihi na ụda kacha njọ bụ mkpọtụ ịnyịnya ibu.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
